title: El Salvador
goal: Read how a twelve-year civil war in El Salvador, intensified by social inequality, left about 75,000 dead, including the army's massacre of civilians at El Mozote.
grammar: Al cabo de: el tiempo transcurrido

items: State how many people the twelve-year war left dead.
Explain why many of those responsible were still unprosecuted a decade later.
Describe how the war displaced and killed civilians.
Describe what happened at El Mozote after nearly two years of war.
Use al cabo de to measure elapsed time.
